entries.title: Psalms 18:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, the servant of the LORD, who spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day [that] the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said,>> I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

entries.title: Psalms 18:2
segments: The LORD [is] my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, [and] my high tower. {my strength: Heb. my rock}

entries.title: Psalms 18:3
segments: I will call upon the LORD, [who is worthy] to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 18:4
segments: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. {ungodly men: Heb. Belial}

entries.title: Psalms 18:5
segments: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. {sorrows: or, cords}

entries.title: Psalms 18:6
segments: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, [even] into his ears.

entries.title: Psalms 18:7
segments: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

entries.title: Psalms 18:8
segments: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc}

words.text: by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 18:9
segments: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness [was] under his feet.

entries.title: Psalms 18:10
segments: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

entries.title: Psalms 18:11
segments: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him [were] dark waters [and] thick clouds of the skies.

entries.title: Psalms 18:12
segments: At the brightness [that was] before him his thick clouds passed, hail [stones] and coals of fire.

words.text: [that was] before him his thick clouds

entries.title: Psalms 18:13
segments: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail [stones] and coals of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 18:14
segments: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

entries.title: Psalms 18:15
segments: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

entries.title: Psalms 18:16
segments: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters. {many: or, great}

entries.title: Psalms 18:17
segments: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

words.text: me: for they were too strong

entries.title: Psalms 18:18
segments: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

entries.title: Psalms 18:19
segments: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:20
segments: ¶The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:21
segments: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.title: Psalms 18:22
segments: For all his judgments [were] before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

words.text: [were] before me, and I did not put away

entries.title: Psalms 18:23
segments: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity. {before: Heb. with}

entries.title: Psalms 18:24
segments: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight. {in...: Heb. before his eyes}

entries.title: Psalms 18:25
segments: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

entries.title: Psalms 18:26
segments: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward. {shew thyself froward: or, wrestle}

entries.title: Psalms 18:27
segments: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

entries.title: Psalms 18:28
segments: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness. {candle: or, lamp}

entries.title: Psalms 18:29
segments: ¶For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall. {run...: or, broken}

words.text: ¶For by thee I have run through

entries.title: Psalms 18:30
segments: [As for] God, his way [is] perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he [is] a buckler to all those that trust in him. {tried: or, refined}

entries.title: Psalms 18:31
segments: For who [is] God save the LORD? or who [is] a rock save our God?

entries.title: Psalms 18:32
segments: [It is] God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

entries.title: Psalms 18:33
segments: He maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], and setteth me upon my high places.

entries.title: Psalms 18:34
segments: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

entries.title: Psalms 18:35
segments: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great. {thy gentleness...: or, with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me}

words.text: . {thy gentleness...: or, with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me}

entries.title: Psalms 18:36
segments: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip. {my feet: Heb. mine ankles}

entries.title: Psalms 18:37
segments: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

words.text: them: neither did I turn again

entries.title: Psalms 18:38
segments: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

words.text: them that they were not able

entries.title: Psalms 18:39
segments: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

words.text: under me those that rose up
against me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

entries.title: Psalms 18:40
segments: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:41
segments: They cried, but [there was] none to save [them: even] unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

entries.title: Psalms 18:42
segments: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

entries.title: Psalms 18:43
segments: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; [and] thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people [whom] I have not known shall serve me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:44
segments: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me. {As soon...: Heb. At the hearing of the ear} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience} {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

words.text: themselves unto me. {As soon...: Heb. At the hearing of the ear} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience} {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

entries.title: Psalms 18:45
segments: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places. {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

entries.title: Psalms 18:46
segments: The LORD liveth; and blessed [be] my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 18:47
segments: [It is] God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me. {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengements for} {subdueth: or, destroyeth}

words.text: under me. {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengements for} {subdueth: or, destroyeth}

entries.title: Psalms 18:48
segments: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man. {violent...: Heb. man of violence}

entries.title: Psalms 18:49
segments: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name. {give...: or, confess}

entries.title: Psalms 18:50
segments: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
